§6✦ QUEST FORGE ✦§r

§oThe old chronicle called this CrazyCraft. Same shattered sky. Same titans.§r

We numbered the disasters in the order you should meet them. Main chapters are the climb. Side pages are hobbies. Secrets stay quiet.

§eClaim this and start walking.§r

§oWood is the first argument the forest will still lose.§r

Tools come from here. Shelter comes from here. Standing still is how the night writes your name on a grave from OpenBlocks.

§7"He said stone was good enough. A Mutant Zombie filed the rebuttal." - Camp Log§r

§eGather 16 wood. Then move.§r

§oA table is not furniture. It is the first machine.§r

Everything later — presses, altars, reactors — is this block with more opinions. The old recipes still work. The new ones assume you built this first.

§7"Fifty years and the same four logs. The table outlived the theories." - Workshop§r

§eCraft a Crafting Table.§r

§oIron is the first metal that bites the things that live here.§r

Stone chips. Wood splinters. Iron is what the book means when it says you have started. You will replace these. You will not skip them.

§7"Survivor steel. Not special. Just required." - Smith§r

§eMake iron tools. Wear the time they buy.§r

§oLeather is a suggestion. Iron is a policy.§r

Infernal nametags and mutant skeletons do not respect cloth. Put iron on all four slots. The Beastiary and the jungle can wait until you have a chestplate.

§7"She said she would run past them. We buried the boots." - Watch§r

§eCraft a full set of iron armor. Wear it.§r

§oDiamonds are still the key. The basement just got louder.§r

Enchanting, the Twilight portal, and a dozen recipes you do not have yet all ask for the same crystal. Below Y-16 the ores change and so does the wildlife.

§7"The glow was new. The teeth were not." - Last Survey§r

§eBring back diamonds. Watch the dark.§r

§oThis is the admission ticket. Not the ending.§r

Twilight, Witchery, the End, and everything with a proper name expect diamond. Below this you are loot. Above it you are allowed to start the climb.

§7"Diamond is how the book knows you are serious." - Quartermaster§r

§eWear diamond. Then open the next chapter.§r

§oChests are a pile with a lid. Drawers are a system.§r

Storage Drawers keep one item in a face you can read from the door. You will own thousands of ingots. The floor is not a plan.

§7"We found his base. We could not find his iron. That was the compliment." - Raider§r

§eCraft a drawer. Fill it with something you will need twice.§r

§oThe wooden box is a prototype. Upgrade it before it overflows.§r

Iron Chests go to gold, diamond, and past that. Same footprint. More honesty.

§7"He had sixteen wooden chests. We called it a fire." - Inspector§r

§eCraft an Iron Chest.§r

§5✦ THE PATH OF THE WITCH ✦§r

§oWhen the barriers fell, magic flooded back into the world. Not the clean, ordered magic of enchantment tables - wild magic. Primal magic. The magic of the old ways.

The witches were waiting. They had preserved the knowledge through millennia, and now they share it with those brave enough to walk their path.§r

§7"The Altar doesn't create power - it channels it. Place it where nature thrives, and nature will fuel your workings." - Coven Elder§r

§eBuild an Altar, Cauldron, and Oven to begin.§r

§oMutandis is how the garden starts lying.§r

The Witches' Oven turns logs into Foul Fume. That fume becomes Mutandis. Mutandis is how vanilla plants become the plants the rest of this chapter spends.

§7"It smelled like a mistake. It grew like a plan." - Coven Ledger§r

§eMake Mutandis. Keep the oven fed.§r

§6✦ THE PHILOSOPHER'S STONE ✦§r

§o[UNLOCKED BY DEFEATING THE LICH]

The alchemists of old sought this artifact for centuries. The ability to transmute base matter into gold, to reshape reality itself through equivalent exchange.

But such power comes with a price. The Lich discovered this truth - and it cost him his humanity. Now his scepter serves as both key and warning.§r

§7"The Stone doesn't create something from nothing. It borrows from elsewhere. Be careful what debts you incur." - Alchemist's Warning§r

§eCraft with a Lich Scepter to prove your worth.§r

§c✦ THE TRANSMUTATION TABLE ✦§r

§o[UNLOCKED BY DEFEATING MOBZILLA]

This is the tool that broke civilizations.

With a Transmutation Table, scarcity becomes meaningless. Gold, diamonds, any material with equivalent value can be exchanged freely. Economies collapsed. Wars were fought. In the end, only those strong enough to claim it deserved to wield it.

You have slain Mobzilla. You have proven strength beyond measure.§r

§4"The Table doesn't make you powerful. Killing Mobzilla made you powerful. The Table is just the reward." - The Last Alchemist§r

§5[UNLOCKED BY DEFEATING THE KING]§r

Dark Matter - condensed alchemical power! Only those who have defeated THE KING may craft this legendary material. The recipe now requires King Scales.

You're almost at the pinnacle of power!

§4[UNLOCKED BY THE QUEEN]§r

§oThe last alchemical step. Not a victory lap.§r

Red Matter is gated on a Queen Scale. That is the receipt. The recipe is in CraftTweaker. The book will not pretend this is a hobby.

§7"You wanted equivalent exchange. She wanted a fight. Both of you got one." - Alchemist§r

§eCraft Red Matter. Then decide whether you are still playing.§r

§d✦ THE TWILIGHT REALM ✦§r

§oThe Twilight Forest existed before the dimensional collapse - a pocket dimension of eternal dusk, ruled by ancient beings of immense power.

When the barriers fell, the Twilight Lords sealed their realm to protect it. But they left a key: water blessed by nature's beauty, ignited by the sacrifice of a diamond.

Those who enter find a land frozen in time - perpetual twilight, massive trees, and castles older than human memory.§r

§7"The lightning that opens the portal? That's the realm testing you. Survive that, and you're worthy to enter." - Twilight Scholar§r

§eDig a 2x2 water pool, surround with flowers, throw in a diamond.§r

§a✦ THE NAGA ✦§r

§oThe Naga guards the threshold of the Twilight realm - a serpent of impossible size, scales harder than iron, coiled in its ancient courtyard for millennia.

It was placed there by the Twilight Lords as a test. Only those who can slay the Naga are deemed worthy to challenge the greater horrors within.§r

§7"The courtyard walls aren't to keep the Naga in. They're to keep the fight fair. Outside those walls, it's just... faster." - Hunter's Warning§r

§eDefeat the Naga and claim its scales as proof of your victory.§r

§5✦ THE TWILIGHT LICH ✦§r

§oOnce a mortal wizard of tremendous power, the Lich sought immortality through forbidden magic. He achieved it - at the cost of his humanity.

Now he rules from his obsidian tower, surrounded by undead servants and protected by magical shields that make him invulnerable to harm. To slay him, you must first destroy the enchanted artifacts that maintain his defenses.§r

§7"Three shields. Three chances for him to kill you while you're trying. The Lich doesn't fight fair - why should you?" - Tower Raider§r

§eDestroy his shields, then strike true.§r

§c✦ THE HYDRA ✦§r

§oThe Hydra predates the Twilight Lords themselves - a primordial beast of fire and fury, sleeping in the volcanic caves beneath the forest.

Three heads. Three personalities. Three ways to die. One breathes fire, one launches explosive projectiles, and one simply bites with teeth that can shear through enchanted armor.§r

§7"You can't kill all three heads at once. You have to be patient, methodical. The Hydra isn't - that's your only advantage." - Sole Survivor§r

§eClaim its Fiery Blood - liquid flame that never cools.§r

§oThe Dark Tower has a ceiling, and the ceiling has a face.§r

The Ur-Ghast runs the tower and a flock that thinks it is weather. Clear the floors. Do not fight it from the front door.

§7"We climbed. It waited. That was the whole strategy, on both sides." - Tower Notes§r

§eKill the Ur-Ghast. Bring back what it drops.§r

§oThe glacier has a palace. The palace has a landlord.§r

The Snow Queen is ice magic with a throne. Alpha Yeti Fur is the proof. This is the last of the numbered Twilight lords on this page.

§7"Pretty, until the floor was a suggestion." - Alpine Log§r

§eDefeat the Snow Queen.§r

§c✦ THE ORESPAWN INVASION ✦§r

§oWhen the dimensional barriers shattered, something worse than monsters came through - an entire ecosystem of impossibly powerful creatures.

Giant insects. Prehistoric terrors. Living nightmares. And ruling them all - titans of godlike power that make dragons look like pets.

The scholars call it 'OreSpawn' - named for the strange ores that appeared alongside these beings.§r

§7"Mothra seems peaceful. Almost cute. Until you realize it's the WEAKEST thing that came through those rifts." - Field Researcher's Final Notes§r

§eYour first encounter with OreSpawn begins...§r

§oThe headline bosses do not respect diamond. They respect this.§r

Ultimate Sword and the rest of the set come from the ugly ores: ruby, uranium, titanium, the ones that glow wrong. Craft them before Mobzilla. Crafting them after is a eulogy.

§7"We had diamond. We had a plan. We did not have Ultimate." - After-Action§r

§eCraft the Ultimate Sword.§r

§oIt does not hunt. It occupies.§r

Mobzilla is the first of the three receipts that unlock ProjectE. Armies are insects. Diamond is a joke. Ultimate gear is the minimum.

§7"Fifty soldiers. Three came back. None wanted to talk about the shadow." - Archive§r

§eKill Mobzilla. Bring the scales. The Transmutation Table is listening.§r

§oThe King is a weather system with a crown.§r

Treat him like the chapter tab said: weather you can stab. The Royal Guardian Sword is the proof this pack uses, because the King himself does not drop a tidy souvenir.

§7"I have seen gods bleed. This one made me put the sentence down." - Champion§r

§eSurvive The King. Hold the Royal Guardian Sword.§r

§oAfter the King. That is the whole warning.§r

The Queen is the last titan on the spine. Red Matter waits on her scale. If you are here early, you are lost. If you are here on purpose, you already know.

§7"You think the King was the end. The book does not." - Final Testament§r

§eKill The Queen. Bring a Queen Scale.§r

§9✦ APERTURE SCIENCE ✦§r

§oAmong the dimensional rifts, one led somewhere... different. A facility. Pristine white walls. Automated testing chambers. And technology beyond anything we'd imagined.

The Portal Gun was the crown jewel - a device that tears holes in space itself, linking two points with a simple trigger pull.§r

§7"The cake is a lie. But the Portal Gun is very, very real." - Test Subject #4827§r

§eNow you're thinking with portals.§r

§b✦ ZERO POINT ENERGY ✦§r

§oFrom the same facility that gave us the Portal Gun came this - a weapon that manipulates gravity itself.

Pick up objects. Throw them at terminal velocity. Watch physics become a suggestion rather than a law.

Some survivors use it for construction. Others use it to launch explosive barrels at their enemies. Both are valid.§r

§7"I once threw a cow at a Creeper. The cow won." - Gravity Gun Enthusiast§r

§oVanilla, with the safety filed off.§r

A Mutant Skeleton is a skeleton that learned extra rules. Unique attacks. Too much health. Hunt one. Do not assume the bow range you remember.

§7"It shot the wall. The wall became the problem." - Range Report§r

§eBring back what it drops.§r

§oThe Mutant Zombie leaves a tool. The tool leaves a crater.§r

The Hulk Hammer slams the ground and sends things away. Including you, if you swing like a tourist.

§7"We asked for a weapon. We got urban renewal." - Quartermaster§r

§eObtain the Hulk Hammer.§r

§oA table that is not a crafting table. Radical.§r

Crayfish is chairs, counters, and the difference between a hole and a house. The climb does not care. You will.

§7"We came back from Twilight. The base still looked like a crime." - Tenant§r

§eCraft a piece of furniture. Sit down on purpose.§r

§oClay that pretends to be a life.§r

Decocraft is hundreds of props. Start with the clay. The kitchen can wait until the walls exist.

§7"He decorated the bunker. The bunker still exploded. It exploded nicer." - Inspector§r

§eCraft Decocraft Clay.§r

§oThe Hall of Heroes is a side tab. This is the door.§r

Suits come off the Suit Assembly Unit. Stark's toys come off the Stark Workbench. Captain America's chestplate is a fine first proof. Batman does not unlock Superman.

§7"He put the shield on. The Warg did not vote." - Recruiter§r

§eCraft a Captain America chestplate. The rest of the closet is optional.§r

§oA bubble canopy, a lump of iron, and the sudden realisation that the ground was optional.§r

MC Helicopters puts real airframes in the pack. Start with a §eBell 47G§r - glass, iron ingots, one iron block - not an Apache and not a bomber. Craft the spawn item, place it, and learn the collective before you buy something with missiles.

§7"He took off. The wrench was still on the seat. The rest of the afternoon was a repair." - Ground Crew§r

§eCraft a Bell 47G. The wrench in the reward is how you keep it in the air.§r

§oA chest you wear, with opinions.§r

Adventure Backpacks hold items and fluids. Some skins do extra work — Bat for night, Squid for gills. Craft the first one. Tanks and a hose are the next page.

§7"He put lava in the left tank. We stopped lending him backpacks." - Outfitter§r

§eCraft an Adventure Backpack.§r

§oBuild a hull. Add a helm. Discover that water was a suggestion.§r

Archimedes' Ships turns a pile of blocks into a vessel. Airships count. The compile button is how you find out what you forgot to attach.

§7"It floated. The kitchen did not." - Captain§r

§eBuild a ship with a helm.§r

§oA shard that learns a face, then prints it.§r

Soul Shards fill by killing the same mob. Higher tiers become a spawner you own. This is how farms stop being a prayer.

§7"We named the shard after the first zombie. It did not care." - Rancher§r

§eCraft a Soul Shard and start the count.§r

Now craft a Soul Cage to place your filled Soul Shard in! The cage will spawn the mob whose souls you collected. Fill a shard to maximum tier for the best spawning rates!

§eTip: Kill 1024 of the same mob type for a Tier 5 shard!§r

Railcraft brings industrial-era steam power to Minecraft! Build a Steam Boiler to generate steam, which can power various machines and locomotives.

Start with a Solid Fueled Firebox - the heart of your steam empire!

§oA boiler that moves, and takes the rest of the train with it.§r

The Steam Locomotive is the end of this side page. Carts, tracks, and a whistle you will regret at night.

§7"Fastest way to travel. Fastest way to meet a cow." - Conductor§r

§eBuild a Steam Locomotive.§r

§oA lock that is not a wooden door and a sign that says please.§r

SecurityCraft starts with a keypad. The code is the whole joke until someone guesses it. Use it on the room you actually care about.

§7"We changed the code. We did not change the sticky note." - Guard§r

§eCraft a Keypad.§r

§oA red line that means the room has opinions.§r

Laser Blocks make a tripwire you can see. Wire them to alarms, doors, or something unkind.

§7"The cat learned the pattern. The raiders did not." - Night Shift§r

§eCraft Laser Blocks.§r

§oWitchery's vampire path is a door that only opens outward.§r

Blood, night, and a list of powers that will get you killed in daylight if you skip the reading. Finish the Old Ways first. This chapter is still mid-book.

§7"Immortal is a strong word for thirsty." - Coven Elder§r

§eStart the vampire path. Bring the kit the previous page made.§r

§6Become a Werewolf!§r

Werewolves transform under the full moon into powerful beasts! Gain immense strength, speed, and the ability to hunt prey. Use wolfsbane to control your transformation.

Find a werewolf and survive its attack to become infected, then gather §6Wolfsbane§r to control your beast.

Craft a Spirit Portal and enter the ethereal Spirit World! This mysterious dimension holds secrets of the dead and is essential for advanced Witchery rituals.

§dBe warned - the Spirit World follows different rules...§r

§cThis is a bad idea with a lid.§r

Pandora's Box rolls the table. Diamonds. Bosses. Both. The Danger Zone tab exists so this does not live on the spine.

§7"I felt lucky. The box felt luckier." - Volunteer§r

§eOpen one if you must. Do it away from the base.§r

Hats add cosmetic headwear to the game! Kill mobs to collect their hats and show off your style. Press H to open the hat menu and equip your collection!

Kill a mob and collect its hat item to complete this quest.

The Chisel is a builder's best friend! It transforms boring blocks into beautiful decorative variants. Stone becomes ornate bricks, marble becomes elegant pillars, and so much more!

Craft a Chisel and right-click any block to see its variants.

§oStairs were a compromise. Carpenter's is the actual angle.§r

Carpenter's Blocks take the texture of whatever you apply. Roofs stop looking like staircases.

§7"We had a house. Then we had a shape." - Mason§r

§eCraft a Carpenter's slope.§r

§oShelves that show the book. Stands that show the armor.§r

BiblioCraft is how a room admits it is finished. The climb does not require this. Pride does.

§7"He built a library. He still could not read the Witchery tooltip." - Archivist§r

§eCraft a BiblioCraft shelf or stand.§r

§oKill it. Bottle the outline. Put it where guests can fail to be polite.§r

A Statue Core captures a mob you have already dealt with. This is not combat. This is filing.

§7"The Hydra looks smaller in plaster. That is the point." - Curator§r

§eCraft a Statue Core.§r

§9It's bigger on the inside!§r

The TARDIS is a time machine and spacecraft from Doctor Who! Craft the TARDIS key and find or craft your TARDIS to travel instantly across dimensions and distances. The interior is fully customizable!

§eAllons-y!§r

§7"Don't blink. Don't even blink. Blink and you're dead."§r

Weeping Angels are terrifying statues that move only when you look away! They lurk in the dark below Y=40, and they can infect you or teleport you somewhere far worse. Bring a pickaxe - nothing else can harm them.

§cWhatever you do... DON'T BLINK!§r

Slay a Weeping Angel and bring back its §bAngel's Tear§r as proof.

Hardcore Ender Expansion completely overhauls The End! New biomes, new mobs, new dungeons, and powerful new bosses await.

Collect End Powder from Endermen to begin exploring the enhanced End dimension.

Food Plus and Food Expansion add tons of new foods and cooking methods! From pizza to sushi, burgers to milkshakes - become a culinary master!

Craft a Fryer to start making delicious fried foods.

§4TragicMC brings doom and death!§r

This mod adds powerful bosses, dangerous dimensions, and unique weapons. The Doom enchantment and Tragedy mechanics add extra challenge.

Craft or obtain a §4Doom Consume§r to embrace the darkness...

Malisis Doors adds animated doors, trap doors, and secret passages! Create doors that slide, rotate, or disappear entirely. Perfect for hidden rooms and impressive entrances.

§eCraft an Iron Sliding Door.§r

§6✦ LUCKY BLOCKS ✦§r

Lucky Blocks can drop ANYTHING - diamonds, enchanted gear, potions, or spawn dangerous mobs! The result depends on the block's luck value.

§eObtain a Lucky Block to complete this quest!§r
§c(Results may vary... dramatically)§r

§oMobs drop bags. Bags drop excuses to keep fighting.§r

Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legend. The color is the only honest part of the tooltip.

§7"I opened a Common. I got string. I opened another Common. I got hope." - Auditor§r

§eOpen a Loot Bag.§r

§dCollect all Twilight Forest boss trophies!§r

Defeat every major boss in the Twilight Forest and collect their trophies as proof of your victories. Display them proudly!

Gather all §dTwilight Forest Trophies§r to complete this challenge.

§6✦ THE CLIMB, FILED §r

§oYou numbered the disasters. Then you walked them.§r

Twilight, the titans, the rest of the spine. This page only wants the three OreSpawn receipts in bulk. It is a closet with standards, not a new boss.

§7"The chronicle is a list. You are the last line." - Keeper§r

§eBring stacks of Mobzilla scale blocks, Royal Guardian proof, and Queen Scales.§r

§oA brick from every sky the pack actually has.§r

Netherrack does not count. End stone does not count. Bring back something that only exists after you left.

§7"He said he had been everywhere. He had a stack of cobble." - Customs§r

§eHold a souvenir from each other world at once.§r

§oEmerald, ruby, royal, Bertha, Ultimate. The ladder, in one scabbard.§r

The chapter asked for the top. This page wants the rungs you threw in a chest and forgot.

§7"He kept the first sword. That is how you know it was not a phase." - Armourer§r

§eCarry every OreSpawn sword tier at once.§r

§oThe forest does not surrender. You empty it.§r

Naga, Lich, Hydra, Ur-Ghast, Snow Queen. Scales, scepters, blood, chops, carminite, fur, and every head on a plaque.

§7"Pretty country. No landlords left to collect the rent." - Surveyor§r

§eHold the full Twilight take at once.§r

§8✦ ROGUELIKE DUNGEONS ✦§r

§oDeep underground, massive dungeon complexes spawn - multi-floor labyrinths filled with spawners, traps, and treasure.

These Roguelike Dungeons are the ultimate test of combat and exploration.§r

§7"Five floors down. Fifty spawners cleared. One chest at the bottom with gear that made it all worth it." - Dungeon Crawler§r

§eGather dungeon loot as proof of your delve!§r

§2✦ THE MINOSHROOM ✦§r

§oBeneath the Labyrinth's endless corridors something waits at the centre. Half minotaur, half fungus, wholly furious.

The maze is the first boss. Mazestone will not yield to an ordinary pickaxe, and the corridors are built to exhaust you long before you reach the heart.§r

§7"Everyone maps the maze on the way in. Nobody remembers the map on the way out." - Labyrinth Cartographer§r

§eBring back its Meef Stroganoff - proof you reached the centre and walked out again.§r

§9✦ THE KNIGHT PHANTOM ✦§r

§oThe Goblin Knight Stronghold was built to contain something. The goblins are only the tenants.

In the vault at its heart drifts an empty suit of armour still fighting a war that ended centuries ago. It does not tire, it does not bleed, and as it dies it simply splits into more of itself.§r

§7"I killed it four times. That was the problem." - Stronghold Breaker§r

§eClaim eight Knightmetal Ingots from the stronghold.§r

§b✦ THE ALPHA YETI ✦§r

§oThe glacier is not empty. Something enormous lives in the ice cave at its base, and it throws its smaller cousins at intruders before it lowers itself to fighting you directly.

Beat it and the Aurora Palace opens. The Snow Queen already knows you are coming.§r

§7"It picked me up. I need you to understand that it picked me up, and then it threw me through a wall." - Glacier Climber§r

§eStrip eight Arctic Furs from the beast.§r

§5✦ THE WITCH'S GARDEN ✦§r

§oEvery brew starts in the dirt. Before the cauldron, before the circles, before any of the interesting trouble, a witch is a gardener.

Witchery hides its two starter herbs in the most ordinary place in the world: tall grass. Break enough of it and Belladonna Seeds and Mandrake Seeds will turn up beside the wheat. Plant them on tilled, watered soil like any crop. Mandrake is the difficult one - a mature root screams when it is torn out of the ground, and the scream hurts anything standing nearby.§r

§7"Two weeds from a field of weeds. That is the whole beginning. Everything after it is just patience." - Hedge Witch§r

§eBreak tall grass around your base until you have four Belladonna Seeds and four Mandrake Seeds.§r

§d✦ CHALK AND CIRCLES ✦§r

§oThe altar gives you power. Chalk is how you spend it.

Ritual Chalk draws a glyph on flat ground; keep right-clicking outward and the glyphs join into a ring, then a second ring, then a third. Stand the required blocks around the circle, throw the ingredients into the middle, and the ritual fires on its own. Ritual Chalk covers the everyday rites - light, weather, plant growth, finding things you have lost.

Draw on flat, solid ground with nothing on top of it, and keep the altar in range or nothing will happen.§r

§7"People think the hard part is the ritual. The hard part is finding nine flat blocks in a hilly world." - Circle Drawer§r

§eCraft a stick of Ritual Chalk and bring it here.§r

§a✦ THE KETTLE ✦§r

§oA cauldron is a serious commitment. A kettle is what you use when you just want to boil something disgusting and see what happens.

Place it, put a heat source underneath, and fill it with water. From there it is the same craft in miniature: add ingredients in order and watch the colour of the liquid change. Get it wrong and you have wasted a mandrake root. Get it right and you have the base for everything that follows.§r

§7"Small pot, small mistakes. That is the entire argument for starting here." - Kitchen Coven§r

§eCraft a Kettle and set it up beside your altar.§r

§6✦ THE WITCHES' OVEN ✦§r

§oAn ordinary furnace burns things. The Witches' Oven burns things and keeps the smoke.

Cook wood, flesh, plants or bone in it and it produces the usual output plus a residue - Breath of the Goddess, Foul Fume, Reek of Misfortune, Exhale of the Horned One. Those residues are the reagents half of Witchery runs on, and you cannot buy them anywhere.

The catch: the oven only saves the residue if a Fume Funnel is stacked directly on top of it. A plain funnel catches some. A Filtered Fume Funnel catches far more. Build a chimney of them.§r

§7"I ran that oven for a week before someone told me about the chimney. A week of good smoke, straight out the window." - Apprentice, furious§r

§eCraft two Fume Funnels and one Filtered Fume Funnel, and stack them on your oven.§r

§b✦ THE DISTILLERY ✦§r

§oThe oven breaks things down by burning them. The distillery breaks them down by being patient.

Feed it a reagent and it separates that reagent into its finer parts - the vapours and tears and essences that the deeper rituals ask for by name. It needs fuel and it needs time, so build it next to the oven and let the two of them work while you are out doing something more dangerous.

This is the point where a witch stops scavenging and starts manufacturing.§r

§7"Everything in this craft is just taking one thing apart carefully enough to find two things inside it." - Still Keeper§r

§eCraft a Distillery and place it beside your oven.§r

§c✦ POPPETS AND PROTECTION ✦§r

§oA poppet is a little cloth figure with your name in it. That is not a metaphor.

Bind one to yourself with a Taglock Kit - right-click yourself, or a bed you have slept in, to capture the taglock - and from then on the poppet takes the hit instead of you. Fall damage, fire, starvation, a sword through the ribs: the doll breaks and you walk away. Different poppets cover different deaths.

They only work if they are with you or on a Poppet Shelf. Build the shelf at home, fill it, and stop dying in caves.§r

§7"I have died eleven times since Tuesday. The shelf has died eleven times since Tuesday. I have died zero times since Tuesday." - Cautious Witch§r

§eCraft a Taglock Kit, a Poppet and a Poppet Shelf.§r

betterquesting:10.name:8: Witchery: The Arthana and the Chalice
betterquesting:10.desc:8:
§e✦ THE ARTHANA AND THE CHALICE ✦§r

§oTwo knives and a cup. Every tradition ends up here eventually.

The Arthana is the ritual blade - a working tool, not a weapon, though it will certainly do the job in an emergency. The Boline is its curved twin, made for cutting plants without ruining what is inside them. The Chalice holds liquid at the centre of a circle and is required outright by several of the deeper rites.

With these three on your belt you are no longer experimenting. You are practising.§r

§7"The blade is not for the goat. The blade is for the rope holding the goat. Please stop asking about the goat." - Coven Elder§r

§eForge an Arthana, a Boline and a Chalice.§r

§4✦ INFERNAL AND OTHERWHERE CHALK ✦§r

§oRitual Chalk handles the polite rites. These two do not.

Infernal Chalk draws the circles that reach downward - binding, summoning, the rites that want a brazier burning and something unpleasant on the other end of the line. Otherwhere Chalk reaches sideways instead, into the spirit realms and the dimensions stacked against this one.

A full ritual often needs all three chalks layered into one circle: ritual glyphs for the outer ring, then infernal or otherwhere for the inner. Draw them in the wrong order and you get nothing. Draw them in the right order and you may wish you had gotten nothing.§r

§7"Ritual chalk asks. Infernal chalk demands. Otherwhere chalk simply opens the door and steps back." - Margery of the Long Silence§r

§eCraft one stick each of Infernal Chalk and Otherwhere Chalk.§r

betterquesting:10.name:8: Witchery: Mutandis and the Wild Harvest
betterquesting:10.desc:8:
§2✦ MUTANDIS AND THE WILD HARVEST ✦§r

§oBelladonna and Mandrake grow in any field. The rest of the garden does not exist yet - you have to make it exist.

Mutandis is a powder that argues with reality. Sprinkle it on a plant and the plant becomes a different plant. Sprinkle it on grass and something new grows there. It is random, it is wasteful, and it is the only route to Wormwood, Wolfsbane, Snowbell and Artichoke. Wormwood in particular is the gateway to everything involving spirits, so keep throwing powder at weeds until it appears.

Mutandis Extremis does the same job harder, for the transformations that plain Mutandis refuses.§r

§7"Throw it at a dandelion enough times and eventually the dandelion gives up and becomes something useful." - Field Notes of a Frustrated Botanist§r

§eCollect one seed each of Wormwood, Wolfsbane, Snowbell and Artichoke.§r

§5✦ THE CIRCLE TALISMAN ✦§r

§oThe great weakness of circle magic is that circles do not travel. Nine flat blocks, three rings of chalk, the right stones at the right points - and all of it stays exactly where you built it.

The Circle Talisman fixes that. Draw a circle once, capture it into the talisman, and carry the whole arrangement in a pocket. Right-click anywhere flat and the circle lays itself back out, glyph for glyph.

This is the last thing the ordinary craft has to teach you. Everything past it costs something you cannot buy back.§r

§7"She drew it once, in a barn, in 1604. She has been redrawing that same barn ever since." - On the Talisman§r

§eCraft a Circle Talisman and capture a completed ritual circle in it.§r

§4✦ LEONARD'S BARGAIN ✦§r

§oThere is a name the covens do not write down, and an urn that is used to call it.

Leonard's Urn and the Alluring Skull are the tools of the infernal side of the craft - the equipment you assemble once you have decided that asking the world nicely has stopped working. Set them in an infernal circle, offer what is asked for, and something will answer.

It always answers. That has never been the difficult part.§r

§7"He is unfailingly polite. He arrives when called, he grants what is asked, and he leaves without argument. I would feel much better if he ever haggled." - The Last Entry in Margery's Journal§r

§eCraft Leonard's Urn and an Alluring Skull.§r

§c✦ THE ROAD TO TORMENT ✦§r

§oTorment is not a place anyone builds a portal to on purpose. It is where the infernal rites lead if you keep following them.

The Brazier is the anchor: a standing fire that holds an infernal circle open long enough for something to come through, or for you to go the other way. A Demon Heart is what you take off whatever comes through first. Bring both and the road is open.

Pack poppets. Pack more poppets than you think the situation calls for. The residents of Torment do not observe the usual conventions about how much damage a thing should do.§r

§7"The fire does not light the room. It lights the way in. Those are not the same service." - Brazier Tender§r

§eBuild a Brazier and claim a Demon Heart.§r

§b✦ THE DREAMWORLD ✦§r

§oThe spirit world is reached by dying carefully. The Dreamworld is reached by going to bed.

Hang a Dreamcatcher above where you sleep and the next night takes you somewhere else entirely - a soft, wrong version of the world where the rules bend and the things you find there follow you back out. Somnian Cotton is what the place is spun from, and what you need to make more of the way in.

You cannot fight your way out of a dream. You can only wake up, and waking up costs you whatever you were carrying when you decided to.§r

§7"I slept eight hours and came back with a headache, a fever, and something in my pocket that was not there on Tuesday." - Dreamer§r

§eCraft a Dreamcatcher and gather Somnian Cotton.§r

§7✦ THE VAMPIRE HUNTER ✦§r

§oNot everyone who studies vampires wants to be one.

The Silver Vat is the hunter's forge - fill it, heat it, and dip ordinary gear until it comes out silvered and lethal to the things that walk at night. A Silver Sword out of that vat cuts a vampire the way an ordinary sword cuts an ordinary man. Garlic, silvered coats and a steady hand do the rest.

The hunters and the covens have an understanding. It is not a friendly one, but it is an understanding.§r

§7"Silver is not magic. Silver is just the one thing they never learned to be brave about." - Hunter, retired, mostly§r

§eBuild a Silver Vat and forge a Silver Sword.§r

§5✦ THE HOSTILE END ✦§r

§oYou remember the End as an empty grey rock with a lizard on it. Forget that.

Hardcore Ender Expansion rebuilt the dimension from the floor up. The island is enormous and unlit, split into real biomes, and everything living on it has been given a reason to hurt you. Endermen no longer wait to be looked at. The obsidian here is not the obsidian you know, and neither is the stone.

Go through the portal properly equipped, mine your way to a defensible spot, and start hauling material home. Everything in this chapter is built out of what you dig up on this trip.§r

§7"Bring a bed. You will not sleep in it. You will need somewhere to set the torches down while you cry." - First Expedition, partial transcript§r

§eHaul back 64 End Stone and 16 Obsidian.§r

§6✦ IGNEOUS ROCK ✦§r

§oSomewhere out past the main island the ground starts to glow.

The burning regions of the End are seamed with Igneous Rock Ore - hot, unstable stone that the mod uses as the base reagent for most of its serious crafting. It is not rare once you find the right terrain, but the right terrain is a long way out over the void, and the things that live there are made of the same fire the rock is.

Take a way home with you. Bridges over the void are not a plan, they are a hobby.§r

§7"Follow the orange. Everything useful in this dimension is at the bottom of something orange." - Prospector§r

§eMine eight Igneous Rock.§r

§d✦ THE INSTABILITY ORB ✦§r

§oThe End is held together badly, and in a few places you can see the seams.

Instability Orb Ore forms where the dimension is closest to giving up on itself. The orb inside is a lump of concentrated wrongness - the reagent that every teleportation and dimensional recipe in this mod eventually asks for. Mining it is exactly as pleasant as that description suggests.

One orb is enough to start. You will want several before you are done.§r

§7"It is not heavy and it is not hot. It is just slightly in the wrong place, all the time, in your hand." - Miner§r

§eRecover an Instability Orb.§r

§b✦ ENDIUM ✦§r

§oThe End has its own metal, and it does not behave like the ones you are used to.

Endium Ore hides in the stranger islands, well away from the spawn platform. Smelted down it gives Endium Ingots, which go into the tools and blocks that survive out here - and into the machinery of the later chapters, which is really why you are collecting it.

Four ingots is the working minimum. Bring more if the trip is going well, because the trip usually stops going well without warning.§r

§7"Iron rusts, gold bends, diamond shatters if you hit it wrong. This stuff just sits there being smug." - Smith§r

§eSmelt four Endium Ingots.§r

§2✦ THE ENDSTONE TEMPLE ✦§r

§oSomeone built here before the dragon. The temple is what they left.

It is a sprawling structure of Ravaged Brick sunk into the endstone, full of locked rooms, pressure-plate puzzles and things that were sealed in on purpose. This is the single richest place in the dimension and the single worst place to be careless. Somewhere inside it is the Temple Caller, which is how you find your way back to it later.

Explore it properly. Half of everything in the rest of this chapter comes out of these rooms.§r

§7"Three of us went in. The temple is very large and very quiet, and I would rather not discuss the other two." - Survivor§r

§eBring back 16 Ravaged Brick and a Temple Caller.§r

§d✦ THE ESSENCE ALTAR ✦§r

§oGems out of the ground are just pretty. The altar is where they are told what to be.

An Essence Altar takes a gem and a supply of essence and pushes one into the other. What you get out depends entirely on what you put in - the same blank stone becomes a teleport anchor, a dash charm or something considerably stranger, purely on the basis of what it was fed.

Build it somewhere permanent. Every remaining quest in this chapter runs through this block.§r

§7"The altar does not create anything. It just holds a gem still long enough for the End to notice it." - Ender Scholar§r

§eBuild an Essence Altar and set it up at your base.§r

§f✦ BLANK GEMS ✦§r

§oA Blank Gem is a decision you have not made yet.

On its own it does nothing at all. Its entire value is that it is empty - an unwritten page that the Essence Altar can write on. Every powered gem in this mod started life as one of these, so make a stack of them before you start experimenting, because the experiments will eat them.

Four is enough to get through the next two quests. It is not enough to get through the next two quests twice.§r

§7"Do not save them for something special. They are the something special. That is the whole trick." - Gemcutter§r

§eCraft four Blank Gems.§r

§9✦ THE TRANSFERENCE GEM ✦§r

§oThe End is enormous and almost entirely empty, which means most of your time out here is spent walking back.

The Transference Gem ends that. Charge a blank gem at the altar, bind it to a place worth returning to, and the walk stops being part of the plan. It is the quality-of-life item that makes the rest of this dimension bearable, and it is worth building before you need it rather than after.

Bind it to your base. Bind it to your base. People do not bind it to their base.§r

§7"I bound mine to a nice view. I have thought about that decision every single day since." - Traveller§r

§eImbue a Transference Gem at the Essence Altar.§r

§3✦ THE SPATIAL DASH GEM ✦§r

§oThe other thing you can write on a blank gem is a very short distance, travelled very quickly.

The Spatial Dash Gem blinks you forward - across a gap, out of a crowd, off the edge of something that was about to become the edge of something. It recharges on its own, which makes it the closest thing this dimension offers to a safety net, and it is the reason experienced players will happily fight over the void.

Combine it with the Transference Gem and the End finally starts to feel like a place you live rather than a place you are visiting.§r

§7"Two blocks is not much of a superpower until the two blocks are the ones between you and the floor." - Void Walker§r

§eImbue a Spatial Dash Gem at the Essence Altar.§r

§c✦ THE DEATH FLOWER ✦§r

§oNothing grows in the End. One thing grows in the temple.

The Death Flower is the strangest object in the dimension: a bloom that only exists in the sealed rooms of the Endstone Temple, and which the mod treats as a genuine second chance. Potted, carried or spent, it is the answer to the problem of a place that kills you faster than you can walk back to your body.

They do not regrow. Every one you use is one fewer in the world.§r

§7"I found four. I have used three. I think about the fourth one more than I think about most people." - Temple Raider§r

§eRecover a Death Flower from the Endstone Temple.§r

§e✦ THE BIOME COMPASS ✦§r

§oThe End has biomes now, and no landmarks whatsoever. Those two facts together are the real difficulty of this dimension.

A Biome Compass fixes it. Feed it a Biome Core keyed to the terrain you are hunting - the burning ground, the infested caves, the enchanted islands - and it will point, steadily, across as much empty void as it takes. This is the difference between searching the End and simply going to the part of it you wanted.

Make this early in your next expedition and every trip after it gets shorter.§r

§7"The compass does not know where you are. It only knows where the interesting part is. Honestly that is the more useful of the two." - Cartographer of Nothing§r

§eCraft a Biome Compass and a Biome Core.§r

§5✦ THE DRAGON REBORN ✦§r

§oThe fight you remember is gone. This one has read your notes.

Hardcore Ender Expansion rewrote the dragon entirely: new attacks, real phases, and a nasty habit of changing its behaviour the moment you settle into a rhythm. Shooting the crystals is still step one, but it is no longer the whole strategy, and standing in the open bow-sniping will get you killed somewhere around the second phase.

Bring the gems. Bring the poppets or the potions or whatever your particular flavour of insurance is. And bring an Enderman Head, because you should not be arriving here without having learned that lesson first.

When it falls, the egg is yours.§r

§7"Everyone has killed the dragon. Nobody in this room has killed that dragon." - Guild Notice, posted twice§r

§eClaim the Dragon Egg and an Enderman Head.§r

§a✦ THE MANTIS ✦§r

§oIt is the colour of the leaves it is standing in, and it is the size of a house.

The Mantis hunts in jungles and heavy forest, which means you will almost always find it by walking into it. It closes distance faster than anything that large has any right to, and the arms are not for show - a single sweep will strip a full set of diamond armour down to scrap.

Fight it in the open. Fight it with something that reaches. Do not fight it in the canopy, where you cannot see which direction it is coming from.§r

§7"I looked at a tree for four minutes. Then the tree looked back." - Jungle Survey, incomplete§r

§eTake a Mantis Claw off it.§r

§2✦ THE BASILISK ✦§r

§oA long low reptile that does not chase you so much as arrive where you were going.

The Basilisk is one of the overworld's roaming heavyweights - it turns up in open country, it hits far harder than its size suggests, and it takes a genuinely absurd amount of punishment before it slows down. Its scales are the reward, and they are worth the fight.

Ranged weapons and a horse. That is the whole tactic and it has never needed improving.§r

§7"Everyone worries about the stare. The stare is a myth. The bite is not a myth." - Herpetologist, briefly§r

§eClaim a Basilisk Scale.§r

§6✦ THE EMPEROR SCORPION ✦§r

§oThe desert already had scorpions. This is what happens when one of them keeps going.

The Emperor Scorpion is armoured across its whole body, so most of what you throw at it simply stops. The tail is the problem: it reaches further than you will estimate, and what it delivers is not a hit so much as a decision about whether you are still in the fight.

Go at dawn, keep the sun behind you, and bring something that heals.§r

§7"Sand does not hold tracks that big for long. That is not comforting. That means it was recent." - Desert Guide§r

§eBring back an Emperor Scorpion Scale.§r

§9✦ THE KRAKEN ✦§r

§oEvery other boss in this chapter lets you stand on the ground while you fight it.

The Kraken lives in deep water and has no intention of coming out. You go to it, in its element, with your armour dragging you down and your air bar counting backwards. It is enormous, it hits through water without any of the usual penalties, and it has all the time in the world.

Potion of Water Breathing. Depth Strider. A boat you can actually get back to. Take all three and it is a hard fight. Take fewer and it is not a fight at all.§r

§7"We lost the ship first. Then the crew. I want to be clear that those happened in that order and it mattered." - Sole Return§r

§ePull a Kraken Tooth out of the deep.§r

§d✦ THE CRYSTAL DIMENSION ✦§r

§oPast the bosses, past the ore, OreSpawn keeps a world of its own.

The Crystal Dimension is a landscape of pink crystal trees and glassy stone, with its own wood, its own workbench, its own furnace and an ingot that exists nowhere else. Getting in means building the dimension's portal out of its own crystal blocks - hover your recipe viewer over a Crystal Pink Ingot and follow the crafting chain backwards until you find the frame.

It is beautiful and it is not safe. The things living there were designed for players who had already killed the Queen.§r

§7"It rings when you walk on it. The whole floor rings. You cannot sneak anywhere and everything already knows." - First Through the Frame§r

§eBring back a Crystal Pink Ingot and a Crystal Apple.§r

§5✦ THE CRYSTAL ARMOURY ✦§r

§oCrystal Pink is the last tier OreSpawn has, and it is only made where it grows.

The crystal tools and armour are forged on the dimension's own workbench, out of its own ingots, and they sit at the very top of the mod's progression - above Ultimate, above anything the bosses drop. This is the end of the OreSpawn road.

Make the sword, make the pickaxe, make the helmet. Then take the set back through the frame and go and find something that still frightens you.§r

§7"I have fought a two hundred block lizard, a queen, and a god. I am telling you the shopping trip afterwards was the good part." - Retired§r

§eForge a Crystal Pink Sword, Pickaxe and Helmet.§r

§8✦ THE COKE OVEN ✦§r

§oRailcraft does not start with rails. It starts with a brick box that turns coal into better coal.

The Coke Oven is a multiblock: twenty-six Coke Oven Bricks laid out as a hollow three by three by three cube, with the access hole in the middle of one face. Feed it coal and wait. What comes out is Coal Coke, which burns far longer than the coal you put in, plus Creosote Oil collecting in the tank underneath.

Build two. You will be running this thing continuously for the rest of the chapter and one oven is never enough.§r

§7"It is a cube of bricks that makes coal angrier. Everything after this is a consequence of that sentence." - Foreman§r

§eStockpile 16 Coal Coke.§r

§6✦ CREOSOTE OIL ✦§r

§oThe black sludge in the bottom of the oven is not waste. It is the second half of the product.

Creosote Oil is what Railcraft treats wood with. Soak your ties in it and they stop rotting; soak them properly and they stop needing replacement at all. It also burns, it also fills lamps, and it is the reason the Coke Oven quietly pays for itself.

Draw it out of the oven with a bucket or a bottle. If you have not put a tank or a valve against the oven wall yet, do that first - the oven will stop working once its internal tank fills up.§r

§7"Smells like a railway station in July. Tastes - I am told - considerably worse." - Yard Hand§r

§eBottle four measures of Creosote Oil.§r

§7✦ THE BLAST FURNACE ✦§r

§oIron is where most players stop. Railcraft treats iron as a raw material.

The Blast Furnace is another multiblock, built from Blast Furnace Bricks, and it does exactly one job: it turns iron into steel. It is slow, it eats Coal Coke as fuel, and it will not be hurried. That is the whole design. Steel is meant to cost you time rather than luck.

While you are here, the Rock Crusher is the other machine worth building on this tier - it takes ore and gravel and squeezes extra output out of them, and it pairs naturally with everything the furnace is doing.

Prove the furnace works by forging something out of the result.§r

§7"Iron is what you find. Steel is what you decide to make. There is a difference and the furnace is standing in it." - Steelmaster§r

§eForge a Steel Pickaxe.§r

§f✦ STEEL PLATE ✦§r

§oOnce the furnace is running, the obvious question is how much steel you can stand to wear.

A full steel set sits between iron and diamond in raw protection but takes considerably more punishment before it fails, which in practice matters more. It is also the armour you can actually afford to replace, because the furnace will still be there tomorrow making more.

Four pieces. Helmet, plate, legs, boots. Then go and stand somewhere you would not have stood last week.§r

§7"Diamond is for people who got lucky. Steel is for people who got organised." - Quartermaster§r

§eForge the full set of Steel armour.§r

§b✦ THE STEAM TURBINE ✦§r

§oA boiler makes steam. A turbine is what you build when you have decided the steam should be doing something more ambitious than pushing a piston.

The turbine is assembled from three parts - a Rotor, and the Blades and Discs that make one up - and it is deliberately expensive, because a working turbine is the top of Railcraft's power chain. It wants a large steady steam supply, which means a proper boiler, which means the fuel line you have been building since the Coke Oven.

Rotors wear out. Keep the parts on hand.§r

§7"Everything in this mod is one machine feeding another machine. The turbine is just the last one in the queue." - Chief Engineer§r

§eCraft a Turbine Rotor along with spare Blades and a Disc.§r

§3✦ MOVING THE FLUID ✦§r

§oThe oven makes creosote at one end of the base and the boiler wants water at the other. Railcraft's answer is not pipes.

Build an Iron or Steel Tank as a multiblock - walls, a gauge so you can see the level, a valve so you can get things in and out - and then move whatever is inside it on rails. The Tank Cart is a barrel on wheels, and paired with a loader and unloader it turns your railway into a working fluid network.

This is the point where the base stops being a room with machines in it and becomes an actual system.§r

§7"Pipes go where you put them. Trains go where you tell them. I know which one I trust at three in the morning." - Yardmaster§r

§eBuild a Tank Cart.§r

§e✦ THE TUNNEL BORE ✦§r

§oThe last machine in the chapter is the one that digs the tunnel for the railway that carries the fuel to the machine that made the machine.

The Tunnel Bore is a cart the size of a house. Load it with track, fuel and a bore head, point it at a mountain and let go. It chews a perfectly sized tunnel through anything in front of it and lays rail behind itself as it goes. A Steel bore head handles ordinary stone happily; a Diamond one handles the things that stop a steel one.

Stand clear of the front. Genuinely. Stand clear of the front.§r

§7"I have watched it work for six hours. It has not once looked like it was going to stop, and I have started to find that upsetting." - Observer§r

§eBuild a Tunnel Bore and fit it with a Steel Bore Head.§r

§d✦ THE SYNAPSE CRYSTAL ✦§r

§oDoom is a direction, and the Synapse is the first road that runs that way.

Synapse Crystals are the raw material of everything TragicMC does with dimensions - small, cold, and faintly wrong to hold. You will find them where the mod's own structures have pushed through into the overworld, which means the ruins, the towers and the places the terrain generator clearly regretted.

Gather four. Nothing further in this chapter opens without them.§r

§7"It is not glowing. I want to be precise about this. The room is darker near it and my eyes are compensating." - Field Note§r

§eCollect four Synapse Crystals.§r

§5✦ THE SYNAPSE CORE ✦§r

§oCrystals on their own are just unpleasant rocks. The Core is what happens when you make several of them agree.

A Synapse Core binds the crystals into a single working component - the power source that the keys, the links and the amulets are all built around. It is the first thing you make in this chapter that behaves like a machine rather than a mineral.

Make one and keep it somewhere you will not knock it off a table.§r

§7"Four rocks in a box. Then it hums. Nobody has satisfactorily explained the humming." - Assembler§r

§eAssemble a Synapse Core.§r

§9✦ THE SYNAPSE LINK ✦§r

§oA core holds power. A link decides where the power is pointed.

The Synapse Link is the connective piece - the part that lets a core reach past the world it is sitting in. On its own it does nothing you can see. Combined with a core, it is half of a door.

The other half is the key, and the key is the next quest.§r

§7"Think of it as a very short piece of rope tied between two places that are not near each other." - Explanation, abandoned halfway§r

§eForge a Synapse Link.§r

§c✦ THE DIMENSIONAL KEY ✦§r

§oCore, link, crystal. Put them together and you get the thing this entire chapter has been walking towards.

The Synapse Key opens TragicMC's own dimension - not a variant of somewhere you already know, but a world built specifically to be hostile to a player who arrived on purpose. Carry the key, find open ground, and use it.

Go in geared. The mod does not have an easy tier and it does not have a tutorial area. What is on the other side of this key is what the mod is actually about.§r

§7"It does not unlock anything. It just makes somewhere else briefly agree to be here." - Keysmith§r

§eCraft the Synapse Dimensional Key.§r

betterquesting:10.name:8: TragicMC: Keys of Nether and End
betterquesting:10.desc:8:
§6✦ KEYS OF NETHER AND END ✦§r

§oThe Synapse key was the proof of concept. These two are the mod rewriting places you already thought you had finished.

The Nether and End keys open TragicMC's versions of those dimensions - the same coordinates, a very different set of residents. If you have been treating the Nether as a solved problem and the End as a completed one, these keys exist specifically to correct that impression.

Make both. Take them one at a time.§r

§7"Same sky. Same stone. Different arithmetic entirely." - Returning Traveller§r

§eForge the Nether Key and the End Key.§r

§e✦ THE APIS AMULET ✦§r

§oTragicMC's amulets are the mod's answer to the fact that its dimensions will kill you.

The Apis Amulet is worn, not swung. It changes what your body does rather than what your weapon does, and in a place where the ordinary rules about damage and recovery have been quietly rewritten, that is worth more than another sword.

Make it before the next expedition, not after the next funeral.§r

§7"The sword decides how the fight goes. The amulet decides whether there is a fight or an incident." - Amulet Wright§r

§eCraft the Apis Amulet.§r

§2✦ TIME AND CORRUPTION ✦§r

§oTwo essences, pulled from opposite ends of the same problem.

Time Essence is what the mod distils out of things that have lasted too long. Corrupted Essence is what it scrapes off things that did not last long enough. Both drop in the deeper dimensions, both are required by the endgame recipes, and neither of them is common.

This is the grind before the payoff. Bring the amulet.§r

§7"One of them makes the clock run backwards. The other one makes the clock stop caring. I keep them in separate boxes." - Collector§r

§eGather Time Essence and Corrupted Essence.§r

§b✦ THE STAR CRYSTAL ✦§r

§oThe essences go into this.

A Star Crystal is the refined form - everything the chapter has taught you, compressed into a single object that the last two recipes both demand. It is the point where TragicMC stops asking you to explore and starts asking you to have finished exploring.

One crystal. Then the weapon.§r

§7"You do not find these. You accumulate them, the way a debt accumulates." - Late Entry§r

§eForge a Star Crystal.§r

§5✦ THE MOURNING STAR ✦§r

§oEvery mod in this pack has a last weapon. This is TragicMC's, and it is named the way it is on purpose.

The Mourning Star is built out of the star crystal and everything that went into making one. It is the reward for having walked the whole synapse chain, opened the keys, survived the dimensions and come back with the essences still in your pack.

There is exactly one thing left after this, and it is not a weapon.§r

§7"They named it for what you carry afterwards, not for what it does. Read that sentence again." - Armourer§r

§eForge the Mourning Star.§r

§4✦ THE DOOMSDAY SCROLL ✦§r

§oThe chapter opened by asking you to embrace doom. This is the paperwork.

The Doomsday Scroll is the last object TragicMC has to give you and the only one that is not a tool, a key or a weapon. It is a statement that the whole chain is finished: synapse, core, link, key, the dimensions behind each of them, the essences, the crystal and the star.

Read it. Then go and see whether the pack has anything left that can frighten you.§r

§7"It is one page. It has been one page the entire time. I simply was not able to read it before." - Last Line of the Journal§r

§eClaim the Doomsday Scroll.§r

§5★ WITCH OF THE WILD ★§r

§oNot a title anyone awards. A description of what you have become.

The blade, the shelf, the still, and all three chalks in one pocket at the same time. Anyone carrying that is not learning the craft any more.§r

§7"She came for a cure for warts. She stayed eleven years." - Village Record§r

§eCarry the full working kit of the craft at once.§r

§d★ ENDER ARCHMAGE ★§r

§oThe dimension was rebuilt to be unlivable. You furnished it.

Both gems, the compass, and a flower that only grows behind a locked door. There is nothing left in the End that can inconvenience you.§r

§7"He does not walk anywhere any more. He simply stops being where he was." - Observed§r

§oRed is how Hell's Kitchen stays honest.§r

Independent line. Nobody else is waiting on this.

§eRetrieve the Daredevil helmet.§r Assemble it in the Suit Assembly Unit.

§oHorns, club, the rest of the vow.§r

§eRetrieve the complete Daredevil suit.§r

§oWe are wearing the suit. The suit is wearing us.§r

Independent line. Nobody else is waiting on this.

§eRetrieve the Venom helmet.§r Assemble it in the Suit Assembly Unit.

§oFull symbiote. Bring a chocolate backup.§r

§eRetrieve the complete Venom suit.§r

§oRhodey painted it like a threat assessment.§r

Independent line. Nobody else is waiting on this.

§eRetrieve the War Machine (Mark 1) helmet.§r Assemble it in the Suit Assembly Unit.

§oMark 1, complete. The unibeam is not a greeting.§r

§eRetrieve the complete War Machine (Mark 1) suit.§r

§oThe overworld was already using a second bestiary. The book just never filed it.§r

Lycanites mobs are not OreSpawn and they are not vanilla. A Soulgazer is how you write one down. Use it on a creature, then open the Beastiary (the key is unbound in Controls until you set it).

§7"I named it. It did not get friendlier." - Field Notes§r

§eCraft a Soulgazer. Point it at something that looks like it has a Latin name.§r

§oSome of them will take a job. The rest will take the treat and you.§r

Wargs are the overworld's obvious mount. A Warg Treat is how you start the argument. Feed a young one until the nametag changes its mind.

§7"The first one bit the hand. The second one waited." - Kennel Ledger§r

§eCraft a Warg Treat. Do not test this on a demon.§r

§oTame is temporary. A Soulstone is the paperwork.§r

Use a Soulstone on a tamed Lycanites creature. It binds to you, shows up in the Pet or Mount manager, and comes back after it dies. That is the difference between a pet and a story about a pet.

§7"We buried the collar. The stone hummed in the chest the whole walk home." - Handler§r

§eCraft a Soulstone. Bind something you can live with.§r

§oAltars are just rocks until someone brings the right insult.§r

A Soulkey activates a built altar: rare subspecies, events, and the one summon this version of Lycanites actually treats as a world boss. Build the altar first. The key does nothing in your pocket.

§7"He turned it in the air like a house key. The ground disagreed." - Witness§r

§eHold a Soulkey. Read the altar schematic before you guess.§r

betterquesting:10.name:8: A Box That Should Stay Shut
betterquesting:10.desc:8:
§oThe Demonic Soulcube is not storage. It is bait.§r

Rahovart is this pack's Lycanites world boss. The cube is how you tell him the address. Asmodeus and Amalgalich are not in this 1.7.10 build. Do not wait for them.

§7"We asked for a light. We got a landlord." - Cult Inventory§r

§eCraft a Demonic Soulcube. Place it only when you mean the rest of the week.§r

§oThe lord of the underworld is one fight, not a chapter of three.§r

Kill him. Bring back a Demon Crystal. That is the receipt. He is late-game on purpose — diamond is the admission ticket, not the loadout.

§7"The name was the scary part until the health bar started." - Last Volunteer§r

§eRetrieve a Demon Crystal. That means he is down.§r

§oThe jungle keeps a second religion under the canopy.§r

Welcome to the Jungle is temples, Saur-Ohn, and stones they thought held the dead. A Soul Sapphire is the first thing that proves you left the path.

§7"It looked like loot. It felt like a stare." - Temple Notes§r

§eBring back a Sapphire.§r

§oFour fragments. One excuse to keep walking into the mist.§r

The Book of Scale is how the Saur-Ohn filed their gods. Find a copy. The Lost World portal is later, and it wants the ceremonial kit — this page is only the reading.

§7"I started it for the recipes. I finished it because the stew was a quest." - Cook§r

§eRetrieve the Book of Scale.§r

§oThe fortress got a filing cabinet that contains a room.§r

A Small Compact Machine is a pocket dimension with a door the size of a brick. The Personal Shrinking Device is how you go in. Put a farm inside if you like your overworld quiet.

§7"We lost a cow. It was still producing. We just could not hear it." - Accountant§r

§eCraft a Small Compact Machine and a Personal Shrinking Device.§r

§oA frame, two wings, and the sudden discovery that falling is optional.§r

The Hang Glider goes on your back. Jump. Shift to dive. Graves from OpenBlocks will still catch you if the landing is a suggestion.

§7"He cleared the wall. The wall was not the problem. The lake was." - Watch§r

§eCraft a Hang Glider.§r

§oJump. Crouch. Same color. Empty shaft. That is the whole manual.§r

Place two Elevators on the same column, three or more blocks apart, dyed to match. OpenBlocks graves still appear when you test this the wrong way. That is also a feature.

§7"We installed a ladder. Then we installed an argument against ladders." - Mason§r

§eCraft an Elevator.§r

§oThree dyes and a frequency. Distance becomes a rumor.§r

An Ender Storage chest is not a vanilla ender chest. Color the three spots. Build a second one with the same colors somewhere you actually go. That is logistics.

§7"We put one in the hole and one in the kitchen. The hole started paying rent." - Quartermaster§r

§eCraft an Ender Chest. Dye it on purpose.§r

§oSome of them come with extra adjectives. That is Infernal Mobs.§r

A nametag that reads like a resume means extra health, extra mods, and loot that is actually worth the swing. Kill one. Check the box when you have.

§7"It said '1UP Regenerating Ghastly.' I said no." - Night Watch§r

§eSurvive an Infernal. Then admit it.§r

§oLevel Up! is a second skill tree the HUD does not introduce.§r

Open the Level Up GUI (default L) and pick a class. Miner, Warrior, Scout - they all pay rent. The Book of Unlearning is there if you hate the first choice.

§7"He picked Freelancer for the points. He still could not punch a Warg." - Trainer§r

§eChoose a class. Check the box when the HUD agrees.§r

§oSync is a second body with your name on the paperwork.§r

A Sync Core is the expensive part. The Shell Constructor is the room. The Treadmill is how a pig pays the power bill. Die near a finished shell and you get a second try.

§7"We kept the spare in the basement. The spare kept us." - Archive§r

§eCraft a Sync Core.§r

§oThe bosses are the headline. The other sky is the commute.§r

OreSpawn keeps more than one world. The floating islands grow trees that do not exist in the overworld. Bring back a Sky Tree Log. Crystal is later, and it waits until the Queen is a receipt.

§7"I looked down. That was the whole mistake." - First Flight§r

§eRetrieve a Sky Tree Log.§r

§oThe airframe is not a trophy. It drinks.§r

A Bell 47G without fuel is lawn art. Craft fuel, refuel the tank, and take off on purpose this time. The wrench from the last quest is how you fix the part you hit the barn with.

§7"He landed. The gauge said no. The field said yes." - Ground Crew§r

§eCraft McHeli fuel.§r

§oThe backpack is a chest until you add plumbing.§r

A Backpack Tank holds fluid. A Hose is how you fill it, dump it, or drink it. Sleep in the bed from the first page. This page is the plumbing.

§7"He filled the left tank with lava. The hose had opinions." - Outfitter§r

§eCraft a Backpack Tank and a Backpack Hose.§r

§oThe skyline grew a landlord. The landlord had a flag.§r

Chocolate Quest puts castles on ridges, ships on the water, and the occasional stronghold under the sand. The banner is how you prove you went inside instead of taking a screenshot.

§7"He said it was abandoned. The flag was still warm." - Survey§r

§eBring back a Chocolate Quest banner. Any colour. The ridge does not care.§r

§oMost swords in this pack are tools. This one remembers who held it last.§r

Moonlight is a named blade from a Chocolate Quest site, not a factory product. It will not skip Mobzilla. It will make the walk to the next silhouette less boring.

§7"He asked if it was Ultimate. It was not. He kept it anyway." - Armourer§r

§eRetrieve Moonlight from a Chocolate Quest dungeon.§r

§oA stick that argues with physics.§r

Chocolate Quest staffs turn up in castle chests. Nature is the polite one. It will not skip a titan. It will make the next hallway less embarrassing.

§7"He asked if it was a wand. The tree outside disagreed." - Librarian§r

§eRetrieve a Nature Staff.§r

§oSomeone else finished this dungeon first. They left the steel.§r

Rusted Chocolate Quest blades are old loot, not a craft. If it is orange, you opened the right chest.

§7"He polished it. It was still rust. He kept it." - Quartermaster§r

§eRetrieve a Rusted Dagger.§r

§oBoots that refuse the ground, briefly.§r

Cloud Boots are a rare Chocolate Quest toy. The pack already has a glider. These are for the hallway after the jump.

§7"He walked off the battlement. The battlement was not impressed. The boots were." - Watch§r

§eRetrieve Cloud Boots.§r

§o"The numbered chapters are the climb. Everything else is how you stay alive on it."§r

Wood, iron, diamonds. The overworld still kills people who skip this page. The right column is the extra HUD: Infernal nametags and a Level Up class. Side tabs are hobbies. The Beastiary is not a hobby. Secrets do not introduce themselves.

§o"A fortress is a filing system that can survive a raid."§r

Drawers, iron chests, a handle that picks the whole box up, a room you can put in a block, an elevator, and a chest that exists in two places. Furniture lives on the Workshop tab — this page is where loot stops living on the floor.

§o"The old magic never died. It merely waited."§r

Witchery sits after Twilight on purpose: you have a real kit now, and the End is still ahead. Altar, garden, chalk, kettle. Each step builds the tool the next one spends.

§o"Power this great must be earned, never given."§r

§6The capstone. Not a mid-book hobby. Equivalent Exchange stays sealed until the story bosses are receipts.§r

§ePhilosopher's Stone§r -> Twilight Lich
§cTransmutation Table§r -> MOBZILLA
§5Dark Matter§r -> THE KING
§4Red Matter§r -> THE QUEEN

§o"In the land of eternal dusk, ancient powers slumber."

The Twilight Forest predates our world. Its lords - the Naga, the Lich, the Hydra, and more - guard secrets of immense power. Only by conquering them in sequence can you prove worthy of the realm's deepest mysteries.§r

§o"They came from beyond the void. They rule now."§r

This is late. Twilight, Witchery, and the End were the warm-up. Sky trees are a commute. Mobzilla, the King, and the Queen are why ProjectE is locked in a cupboard. Treat them like weather you can stab.

§o"In chaos, humanity found wonders. And several OSHA violations."§r

Portal Guns, Gravity Guns, shields for the off-hand, mutant trophies, a spare body, superhero kits, helicopters that drink fuel, and a snack that turns you into a particle effect. Pets have their own Workshop tab now.

§o"Leave the base. Come back. Ideally still shaped like yourself."§r

Backpacks with plumbing, a glider, ships, soul shards, and a lock on the door. The ridge may grow a castle. The water may grow a ship. A banner proves you went in. A staff, rusted steel, or Cloud Boots are chest toys. Moonlight is the named blade. None of it is a factory, and none of it skips Mobzilla. SecurityCraft is how you stop the next raid from being a tour. Railcraft moved to its own Side tab — it grew out of this page.

§o"Every one of these is a door that only opens outward."§r

Blood, moon, and the dimensions behind the veil. Finish the Old Ways first. This is still mid-book - the titans have not happened yet, and that is the correct amount of fear.

§o"Aesthetics are a combat statistic. Ugly bases die first."§r

Chisel, Carpenter's, Crayfish, Decocraft, BiblioCraft, doors that deserve a name, hats, dinner, hidden walls, and a maid who will have opinions. This is the Workshop. The numbered chapters do not care about your staircase. You should.

§cDANGER AHEAD§r

Doctor Who's box, the angels that win if you blink, a box that should have stayed shut, and a jungle that keeps its own gods. HEE and TragicMC graduated to numbered chapters. This page is the remaining bad ideas.

§o"Fortune favors the bold. And sometimes, the lucky."

§6The old world left behind treasures - Lucky Blocks of condensed chance, Loot Bags dropped by fallen champions.§r

Complete legendary milestones. Claim ultimate rewards. Write your name in the Chronicle of Chaos.

§b✦ MAGICAL COMPANIONS ✦§r

§oWorkshop tab. Pocket creatures, not the plot.§r

Grab any pet in any order. The four legendaries — Cloud, Slime, Black Hole, Pufferfish — use the large ornate border. Nothing on this page gates the next.

§oIf this page is blank, that is working.§r

Nothing here introduces itself. Retrieval still counts in your pockets. When a title appears, you already knew why.

The numbered chapters are the climb. This closet is the receipts you were not told to keep.

§o"The lizard was never the hard part."§r

The End comes after the craft, before the OreSpawn gods. It is dark, huge, and rebuilt to kill equipped players. Survive the trip, mine the reagents, find the temple, then look for the dragon.

§o"Nothing in this mod works on its own. That is the entire point of it."§r

Side page. Railcraft is a factory, not a final boss. Coke, creosote, steel, steam, a railway. No magic shortcut. Start at the Coke Oven and work down.

§o"Doom is not an event. Doom is a destination, and it has a road."§r

After the titans. Crystal to core to key to worlds that assume you already finished the others. Bring the best of whatever the rest of the pack gave you.

§o"Range is a privilege. So is having a roof tomorrow."§r

ICBM is the optional silo. It is not the story spine and it is not how you skip Mobzilla. Grenade first. Launcher when you mean it.

The horizon landmarks moved. Castles and ships are on Exploration now.

§b✦ INDEPENDENT SUIT LINES ✦§r

§oSide tab. Not the spine. Batman does not unlock Superman.§r

Every column is its own character. Iron Man Marks share one family line. The costume closet at the top is optional and locks nothing.

Build suits at the Suit Assembly Unit. Stark armor at the Stark Workbench.

§o"The overworld already had a second book. This is it."§r

Lycanites is not a stamp collection. Soulgazer, treat, soulstone, key, cube, Rahovart. That is the whole campaign. Asmodeus and Amalgalich are not in this build.

Open the Beastiary from Controls. Bind the key. The mobs will not wait.
